title: PlayerBossBar
description: Show the player's HP in the boss bar!
body:
Using this plugin, you can set a boss bar for a specific player to display their HP in real time. It only works for one player at a time. It will be further developed.

Commands:
/playerbossbar <nickname> <title> <color> - create bossbar
/playerbossbar <radius> <number> - set up radius
/playerbossbar off - disable bossbar
